title: 儚い仕事人
restoration: 原画の切り出し・規格内の紙色補正（拡大・反転なし）

tasks.script: RIGHT: Hiyori, adult 25, reddish brown ponytail over shoulder, ivory sleeveless blouse and black work pants, wistfully leans over a cafe laptop, posing like a tragic heroine, saying softly 「私、壊れてしまいそう……」 Hajime looks concerned. She IS genuinely tired, not acting a serious disease. LEFT: while still holding the same elegant weary pose with one hand at her cheek, her other hand efficiently taps send on a laptop whose screen shows three big clean check marks by 「議事録」「経費」「引継ぎ」. Hiyori calmly says 「全部、送信しました。」 Hajime impressed says 「仕事は速い。」 No screaming personality switch, no mockery of actual fatigue.
